body:
FYI there was already quite a bit of discussion on this problem, see:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/62444

To see how it is solved in 3.x.
I can't remember what the final state was on 4.x, I think Juan was handling it.

I have added this method to be used internally in the source code, since it will never need to update the children cache for deleting all children which will result in looping over all the children when we use `get_child_count(false)` or looping over them every time `get_child` is called, currently i feel like it can be used only for the editor, since for scenes it's only used inside FileDialog and can also be used for ColorPicker swatches.
I have added it only for editor since it will be rarely used inside `scene` folder.

I added this method to be used only internally by the editor to improve performance when clearing nodes, (ie. for `EditorInspector`), but I noticed it was marked as a feature proposal. Since this doesn’t affect  <s> the public API or</s> scripting and is limited to editor classes, do I still need to create a feature proposal for it?

Edit: The method is technically public in Node, but it’s wrapped in `#ifndef TOOLS_ENABLED`.
